Options: pool_aggregate = profile describes combined contributors to that pool; not separately observed profile for each contributor. all_individuals_resolved = assigns separate complete expression profile to every contributing animal within that pooled library. some_individuals_resolved. new_single_animal. not_stated etc.

Those separate individual profiles are available in the study but are not observations produced by the four selected eight-animal pooled libraries." That indicates selected pooled libraries are not individual profiles. The reported bulk analysis counts reads into gene-expression profiles for prepared libraries. For each 8-animal pool, one library profile representing pool aggregate. So q2 = pool_aggregate.
